name: Roterstern
description: Fire explosive rounds with his blaster, Roterstern, damaging the target hit and enemies behind them.

stats.CASTING: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact
stats.RANGE: Cone-shaped spell field with a 5m radius and an apex angle of 90°
stats.DAMAGE FALLOFF: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 70% at 40m

name: Kraken Impact
description: Leap high, then dash forward and slam down with the bionic arm by pressing {{#switch: {{{p|}}} | PC = Left-Click | PS5 = link=| | Xbox = link=|}}, dealing damage to enemies in range, marking them for Culling. Marked enemies will perish instantly if their health falls below a certain threshold, recharging the bionic arm for another Kraken Impact within a short period.

name: Bionic Hook
description: Charge up and launch a hook with his bionic arm, reeling in the first target hit and enemies lurking behind.

stats.CASTING: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact
stats.RANGE: The projectile can travel up to 10m with a 0.5s charge. As the charge time increases, it can reach a maximum distance of 20m with a 1s charge
stats.SPELL FIELD RANGE: Cone-shaped spell field with a 4.5m radius and an apex angle of 80°

name: Trooper's Fist
description: Dash forward, seizing enemies along the path and Launch Up enemies at the end of the dash.

name: Tainted Voltage
description: Charge up and launch a powerful electrical punch with the bionic arm in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies within range and Slowing them. This ability can Knock Down flying heroes.

stats.CASTING: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory

name: Ceaseless Charge
description: Roterstern reloads automatically while the bionic arm is in action, granting Winter Soldier Bonus Health

stats.BONUS HEALTH (SELF): 40 (Bionic Hook & Tainted Voltage) 50 (Trooper's Fist, Kraken Impact) 30 (Stellar Impact)

name: Stellar Impact
description: Inspired by Captain America's resolve, Winter Soldier can leap to the aid of a designated ally, slamming the ground with his mechanical arm to deal damage to nearby foes and grant Bonus Health. Additionally, Captain America and Winter Soldier can interact with each other once both parties confirm. The duo collides and unleashes a shockwave that deals damage and slows enemies.
